title: Hearty Homemade Dutch Onion Hash
description: A rich and savory Dutch dish featuring caramelized onions and tempered chocolate, perfect for a lazy Sunday morning. This Whole30-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection in a scallop shell vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, caramelize the onions over medium-low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a double boiler, melt the dark chocolate, stirring occasionally.
Temper the chocolate by cooling it to around 82 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add the caramelized onions, tempered chocolate, and chopped scallions to the bowl and stir to combine.
Spoon the mixture into 4 scallop shells.
Bake the hash for 15 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove the hash from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
